newsitem.title: USA: Kitty Hawk hurt by air logistics decline.
newsitem.headline: Kitty Hawk hurt by air logistics decline.

text.p: Kitty Hawk Inc, a provider of charter air freight and logistics services, said its November 30 first-quarter fell principally from a decline in its air logistics business resulting from a previously reported strike against the company's major auto manufacturing customer.
"That strike was settled and business with this customer has returned to historical levels," said chairman Tom Christopher in a statement.
Kitty Hawk posted quarterly earnings of $0.18 per share, down from $0.25 a year earlier. Revenues fell to $25.4 million from $36.0 million.
